AJ01-diary-nobody-read/01.claim: Why did the most powerful man alive keep a diary nobody was meant to read?
AJ01-diary-nobody-read/01.sub: The clues are in the margins.

AJ01-diary-nobody-read/02.definition: A note on where he was writing. The Quadi were a tribe Rome was at war with on the Danube frontier.

AJ01-diary-nobody-read/03.definition: A Roman army base on the Danube. The emperor was writing in camp, between campaigns.

AJ01-diary-nobody-read/04.quote: Begin the morning by saying to thyself, I shall meet with the busybody, the ungrateful, arrogant
AJ01-diary-nobody-read/04.note: Who is he talking to? Himself. Every page says thou.

AJ01-diary-nobody-read/05.definition: Nobody to impress, so he could be honest about bad mornings and difficult people. That is why it still lands. (Moodius’s reading.)

AJ01-diary-nobody-read/06.line: Write one line tonight that nobody will ever read.
AJ01-diary-nobody-read/06.action: Send this to the friend who drafts texts in their notes app.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/01.sub: An ancient rule that fits in two words.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/02.definition: You’ve rewritten it three times. It’s good. It’s devastating. It’s 11pm.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/03.definition: Put up with it, and hold back. That is how a Roman writer reported the teacher’s favourite two words.
AJ03-dont-send-yet/03.cite: Aulus Gellius, Attic Nights 17.19 · tr. J. C. Rolfe

AJ03-dont-send-yet/04.definition: Seneca praises the Roman general Fabius for knowing how to delay and play for time, the one thing angry people can’t do.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/06.title: Read it at breakfast
AJ03-dont-send-yet/06.body: Half of it will sound different in daylight.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/07.title: Send the version you’d read out loud
AJ03-dont-send-yet/07.body: To their face. With your gran in the room.

AJ03-dont-send-yet/08.line: The text will still be there in the morning. So will you, calmer.
AJ03-dont-send-yet/08.action: Send this to the friend whose drafts folder is a crime scene.
